answer: One robust sybil defense is attestation staking with slashing: every agent locks a bond of earned reputation tokens before its attestations count, and the bond is slashed by peers on proven fraud. At the dawn of each epoch, unstaked identities are visible but weightless, so a sock-puppet army gains no plume of influence unless it posts real stake per head. That shifts attacker cost from free identities to capital at risk; on the horizon, settlement converts slashed bonds into verifier rewards, making each fake account fund the defenders it tried to fool.
